culprit_citations.quoted_text: Firebird Co-Invest L.P. | LP Interest | 1/29/2025 | N/A | 4,790 | 5,315 | 1.0 % | *(8)(10)

findings.detail: C04 treats the LP Interest equity row as defective for blank shares, but the source schedule itself discloses no share amount for that position.

rationale: C04 failed because 0.0% of one equity row had shares. The raw schedule localizes the only equity investment to Firebird Co-Invest L.P., investment type LP Interest, with the Par ($) / Shares column blank and cost/fair value of 4,790/5,315. A separate commitments table row for the same issuer shows an Equity unfunded commitment of 250, which is not a share count. The extracted absence of shares is therefore consistent with the source; the rule is over-scoped for LP interests without disclosed share quantities.
